seoTitle: How to Change Your TradingView Password Safely
metaDescription: Learn how to change your TradingView password from account settings, or reset it if you're locked out, plus tips to keep your account secure.
intro: Whether you want to update your TradingView password for security reasons or you've lost access entirely, there are two different paths to take. This guide covers changing the password while logged in and resetting it when you can't sign in at all.

steps.heading: Change your password from account settings
steps.body: While logged in, go to your TradingView account settings and choose the option to update your password with your current one plus a new one.

steps.heading: Reset your password if you're locked out
steps.body: If you can't log in, use the forgot password option on the login screen to trigger a reset link sent to your registered email.

steps.heading: Verify your identity via email
steps.body: Open the reset or confirmation email promptly, since these links can expire, and follow the prompts to set your new password.

steps.heading: Fix a missing confirmation email
steps.body: Check your spam folder and confirm you're using the correct registered email address if the change or reset email doesn't arrive.

steps.heading: Follow good password security practices
steps.body: Use a unique, strong password for TradingView and avoid reusing passwords from other accounts to reduce the risk of unauthorized access.

faq.question: Can I change my password without knowing the old one?
faq.answer: No, if you don't know your current password you'll need to use the forgot password / reset flow instead of the account settings option.

faq.question: How often should I change my TradingView password?
faq.answer: There's no strict rule, but it's good practice to update it periodically or immediately if you suspect unauthorized access.

faq.question: Why didn't I get the password change confirmation email?
faq.answer: Check your spam folder first, and confirm the email address on file is correct and accessible.

faq.question: Does changing my password log me out of other devices?
faq.answer: Changing your password can end active sessions on other devices as a security measure, so you may need to log back in on each one.
